content: Vite latest is 8.3.0 (npm registry, 2026-09-11); Vite 7 shipped June 2025 (Rolldown preview, Node 20.19+/22.12+); @vitejs/plugin-react 6.1.1. A Vite build adds package.json, node_modules, dev server, and a dist output for every deployment — directly contradicting the project's serve-a-folder model and its explicit no-build constraint. Tradeoffs: Vite buys HMR, TS, npm imports, minification, and removes the CDN dependency, but for a ~500-line LAN tool served over python http.server the cost is unjustified. Only adopt when npm dependencies, TypeScript, or multi-page asset pipelines are actually needed.
